stem.en: A gas goes from state A to state B by two completely different processes, one direct and one via several intermediate steps. How does the change in internal energy compare between the two paths?
stem.et: Gaas liigub olekust A olekusse B kahe täiesti erineva protsessi kaudu, üks otse, teine mitme vahepealse sammu kaudu. Kuidas võrdub siseenergia muutus nende kahe tee vahel?

label.en: It is exactly the same for both paths, since internal energy depends only on the states, not the path
label.et: See on mõlema tee jaoks täpselt sama, sest siseenergia sõltub ainult olekutest, mitte teest

label.en: It differs, since the two processes involve different amounts of heat and work
label.et: See erineb, sest kaks protsessi hõlmavad erinevaid soojuse ja töö koguseid

label.en: It is larger for the path with more intermediate steps
label.et: See on suurem rohkemate vaheastmetega tee puhul

label.en: It cannot be compared without knowing the gas's exact composition
label.et: Seda ei saa võrrelda, teadmata gaasi täpset koostist
